svg.text: REFPLAT · REFERENCE INTERNAL DEVELOPER PLATFORM ON AWS
Read bottom-up: cloud foundation → cluster → declarative control plane → tenancy → agents → delivery → edge.
Security/Compliance and Observability span every layer; a data & resilience strip underpins it. Everything is git-driven and reconciled.
claim → governed like a tenant workload
registry scope · cosign/SLSA · PSA · PDB gen
git claims → Argo CD → Crossplane + Kyverno → envs
dev → Backstage → PR → derived infra materializes
self-hosted CI → signed + attested → Kyverno verify
XAgent claim → Crossplane → governed agent workload
incident → triage agent → owner-routing → pages team
